shell.changelog: Beta 0.2.0-beta.12: theme editor reworked around a token catalogue - grouped categories with collapsible spoilers, live preview, search, per-category non-default markers; rows bind to the token name the theme really uses; docs/themes.md documents storage and alias rules. Theme editor could fail to render because of a mixed ?? / || expression; a test now parses every mini-app script. Not yet verified on a physical device.
